MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, as provided. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, meeting Sector Strength; leadership is mixed across three sectors in the SP100 top five performers, while Technology is the sole negative sector and 1W/1M pullbacks in AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%, CORRECTION) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%, CORRECTION) argue against a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads at +3.45% for the week, with GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%, ABOVE TREND) and TSLA (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +12.91%, ABOVE TREND) strong. Healthcare follows at +2.26%, led by LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%, ABOVE TREND); Industrials gained +1.65%, though leadership is uneven, with GD (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%, ABOVE TREND) strong and CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%, BELOW TREND) weak.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is the clear laggard, down 4.05% for the week and 6.51% for the month; GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%, BELOW TREND) is weak. Communication was nearly flat for the week (+0.04%) and negative for the month (-1.22%), while Industrials’ positive sector average masks weakness in BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%, BELOW TREND) and CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%, BELOW TREND).

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Among the SP100 names in the supplied leaders, the top five are GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%, ABOVE TREND), LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%, ABOVE TREND), GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%, ABOVE TREND), TSLA (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +12.91%, ABOVE TREND), and UPS (1W: +7.11% | 1M: +15.29%, ABOVE TREND). Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors across the top five), with Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary contributing most of the strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Among the SP100 names in the supplied laggards, the bottom five are QCOM (1W: -6.32% | 1M: -9.50%, BELOW TREND), CRM (1W: -7.80% | 1M: -3.18%, BELOW TREND), BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%, BELOW TREND), CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%, BELOW TREND), and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%, BELOW TREND). Weakness spans Technology and Industrials, with GOOGL and CAT showing the sharpest one-month declines in this group.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum among the listed SP100 leaders: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%, ABOVE TREND), LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%, ABOVE TREND), and GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%, ABOVE TREND). Watch TMUS (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%, RECOVERY) for follow-through; AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%, CORRECTION) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%, CORRECTION) show short-term pullbacks against positive monthly returns.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with the sector down 4.05% for the week and 6.51% for the month; GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%, BELOW TREND), META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%, BELOW TREND), and NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%, BELOW TREND) are all BELOW TREND. Sector breadth by constituent count is unavailable in the supplied data; the sector summary covers 24 stocks and shows a negative average return.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials rose 0.96% for the week and 4.15% for the month, with key payments names firm: JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%, ABOVE TREND), V (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +14.93%, ABOVE TREND), and MA (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +16.18%, ABOVE TREND). Sector breadth by constituent count is unavailable; the supplied sector summary covers 20 stocks and shows positive average returns.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare gained 2.26% for the week and 10.22% for the month, led by LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%, ABOVE TREND) and supported by GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%, ABOVE TREND). Defensive performance is mixed: JNJ (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +5.62%, ABOVE TREND) is firm, while UNH (1W: -2.66% | 1M: +11.44%, CORRECTION) has pulled back; constituent positive-count breadth is unavailable.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio stance?
Favor selective exposure to Healthcare and Consumer Discretionary strength, while monitoring the sharp Technology drawdown; GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%, ABOVE TREND) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%, ABOVE TREND) show relative strength. Style: mixed / no clear leadership, consistent with NEUTRAL and 10/11 sectors positive; avoid treating the broad sector count as confirmation of uniform stock strength.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%, ABOVE TREND) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%, ABOVE TREND) if gains hold; GD (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%, ABOVE TREND) if its raised-guidance catalyst continues to be reflected in price. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%, BELOW TREND) and CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%, BELOW TREND) if selling pressure persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare, up 2.26% for the week and 10.22% for the month, with LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%, ABOVE TREND) leading; Consumer Discretionary is also strong at +3.45% for the week. BEARISH: Technology, down 4.05% for the week and 6.51% for the month; its constituent positive-count breadth is unavailable, but its 24-stock average return is negative.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price-level data was not supplied, so monitor trend triggers instead: NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%, BELOW TREND) for stabilization, GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%, BELOW TREND) for a slowing decline, and JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%, ABOVE TREND) for continued positive momentum. A sustained improvement in both timeframes would strengthen confirmation; renewed weekly weakness would leave the current trend labels intact.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GD (+80): Q3 earnings lifted guidance as backlog reached a record; price action confirms the catalyst, with GD (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%, ABOVE TREND). LLY (+45): reported pipeline trial wins; price confirms the positive tone, with LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%, ABOVE TREND).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
JPM (-40): coverage flagged an earnings miss, but price action diverges from the negative tone: JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%, ABOVE TREND). TSLA (-35): commentary cited EV-share pressure despite strong price momentum, a divergence to monitor; TSLA (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +12.91%, ABOVE TREND). BA (-35): concerns about persistent operating problems align with weakness; BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%, BELOW TREND).

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, with 10/11 sectors positive and leadership mixed across three sectors; style is mixed with no clear Growth-versus-Value leadership. Relative strength is evident in GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%, ABOVE TREND) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%, ABOVE TREND). Monitor Technology weakness and sentiment-price divergence in TSLA (1W: +7.41% | 1M: +12.91%, ABOVE TREND), alongside pullbacks in AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%, CORRECTION) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%, CORRECTION).
